_meta.title: 1 John — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 5 chapters of 1 John. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 62 1 John); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~2-4, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.

verses.text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.plain: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.

verses.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.plain: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.plain: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father — Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

verses.text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.plain: Do not love the world or anything in it. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.

verses.text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.plain: See what great love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are. The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

verses.text: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.plain: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for one another.

verses.text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.plain: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

verses.text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.plain: Beloved, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

verses.text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.plain: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

verses.text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.plain: There is no fear in love. Perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

verses.text: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.plain: We love because he first loved us.

verses.text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verses.plain: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

verses.text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.plain: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
